# How long each package takes under `go test -race`, used only to balance shards.
#
# MEASURED ON THE CI RUNNER, NOT ON A DEVELOPER MACHINE. The first version of
# this file used local timings and they did not transfer: sqlstore is 18% of the
# suite locally and 45% on the runner, while nodebootstrap is 45s locally and 4s
# there. Packing from the wrong table is worse than packing from none, because
# it looks balanced. These numbers come from the shard logs of the run that
# introduced the split, which report each package's own duration.
#
# ONLY THE HEAVY PACKAGES ARE LISTED; the rest take the planner's default. A NEW
# PACKAGE NEEDS NO ENTRY — the planner takes its package list from `go list`, so
# an unlisted package still runs, on the default weight. Nothing about
# correctness depends on this file; only balance does.
#
# REFRESH BY READING THE SHARD LOGS when the shape of the suite changes.
#
# <seconds> <import path>
174.2 github.com/KazuhaHub/passwall-sub-panel/internal/adapters/sqlstore
27.6 github.com/KazuhaHub/passwall-sub-panel/internal/service/nodeagentupgrade
25.6 github.com/KazuhaHub/passwall-sub-panel/internal/service/nodesync
19.0 github.com/KazuhaHub/passwall-sub-panel/cmd/panel
18.3 github.com/KazuhaHub/passwall-sub-panel/internal/service/rollup
18.1 github.com/KazuhaHub/passwall-sub-panel/internal/transport/http/handler
16.0 github.com/KazuhaHub/passwall-sub-panel/internal/service/health
6.2 github.com/KazuhaHub/passwall-sub-panel/internal/app
4.2 github.com/KazuhaHub/passwall-sub-panel/internal/pkg/nodebootstrap
3.8 github.com/KazuhaHub/passwall-sub-panel/internal/service/clientdoc
3.8 github.com/KazuhaHub/passwall-sub-panel/internal/service/user
2.7 github.com/KazuhaHub/passwall-sub-panel/internal/adapters/xui
